chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about one who forgot the visitation of the House until he returned to his family, so he said: 'It does not harm him if he has fulfilled his rituals.'

key_terms.مَنَاسِكَهُ: His rituals (referring to the essential rites of Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Does forgetting to visit the Kaaba invalidate one's Hajj?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies that the Ziyarah of the Kaaba, while highly recommended, is not a mandatory pillar (Rukn) whose omission invalidates Hajj. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) assures the pilgrim that forgetting this act does not incur penalty as long as the core rituals are fulfilled, reflecting the Shia juristic distinction between essential obligations and recommended acts.
